PR: Chart docs: Add enableGatewayAPI feature gates [closed; labels release-note, approved, lgtm, kind/documentation, size/M, dco-signoff: yes, ok-to-test, area/deploy]
### Pull Request Motivation

This commit adds the `enableGatewayAPI` parameter to the chart config example. It also updates the feature gate list with their default values.

It was hard for me to find the `enableGatewayAPI` parameter required to turn on gateway API support through the helm chart. It was even more confusion since the `ExperimentalGatewayAPISupport` is still active (although on by default since 1.15).

This modifi…

config example to match all the [flags listed in the 1.16 documentation](https://cert-manager.io/docs/cli/controller/).

I hope this makes it clearer for others trying to enable it.
